body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Builds and tunes GPU kernels for simulation, AI, and signal processing. A GPU computing toolkit provides compilers, profilers, and libraries (BLAS, FFT, RNG) for writing CUDA, HIP, or SYCL kernels and tuning occupancy and memory coalescing. Real implementations include CUDA Toolkit, ROCm, and oneAPI. It profiles kernels with roofline analysis and validates numerics against CPU references.

body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for GPU Computing Development Toolkit, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Kernel compilation for NVIDIA/AMD/Intel GPUs). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Kernel compilation for NVIDIA/AMD/Intel GPUs and Profiling: occupancy, memory throughput, roofline. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (GPU-accelerated numerical computing framework) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
